records.text: Owens said she had it “on good authority” that a priest told people there were marital issues between Charlie and Erika Kirk. Both the direct informant and the priest remain unidentified; the account is Owens’s characterization of secondhand information.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I have it on good authority that the priest has told people that there were some marital issues.
